invariants.claim: Success requires Refunding and 1–100 submitted IDs.
Every submitted ticket exists and is currently owned by msg.sender; repeated IDs fail after the first burn.
Refund equals the sum of inclusive stored range lengths times ENTRY_PRICE and debits liability before payout.
Successful burns clear ownership and individual approvals and decrement owner balances while preserving historical ranges.

calls.propagates: Rejects entered state before body, writes entered during all calls, restores not-entered afterward; direct chosen-slot access (ReentrancyGuard.sol L69-L73, L88-L118; StorageSlot.sol L93-L97).
Returns only for required lifecycle (Raffle.sol L573-L575).
Nonzero current ownership or revert; supplies existence check before range read (ERC721.sol L61-L63, L146-L148, L426-L431).
Returns stored endpoints; establishes neither existence nor ordering (Raffle.sol L451-L455).

Zero destination bypasses Raffle screening; zero auth skips base authorization. Removes owner, clears individual approval, decrements owner balance, emits Transfer; zero previous owner reverts (Raffle.sol L497-L502; ERC721.sol L216-L244, L303-L308, L383-L399).
Screens fixed destinations and canonical implementation, conditionally registry-checks code-bearing recipients, then calls safeTransfer (Raffle.sol L564-L566, L598-L604).
Returns immutable implementation used by destination screening; reached only when preceding OR comparisons are false (RaffleFactory.sol L42, L89-L91; Raffle.sol L599-L601).
Returns registry bit when destination has code and prior screen is false (RaffleFactory.sol L54, L123-L125; Raffle.sol L602-L604).
Bubbles call failures; accepts success word 1 or successful empty returndata with code; otherwise reverts. Does not measure actual payment (SafeERC20.sol L33-L37, L176-L200).

Receives zero native value and encoded transfer arguments with forwarded gas. Economic transfer semantics assumed; token may fail, return hostile data, or attempt callbacks after burns/debit (SafeERC20.sol L176-L196; Raffle.sol L364-L369).
